name: token_balanced_openhands_wildchat
purpose: Quick two-run validation of unified LRU versus an offline-selected fixed Agent/request KV-token partition. GLM is intentionally excluded and reserved for later online validation.

selection.metric: sum of final prompt_tokens per selected session
selection.request_policy: keep every request session in the source workload
selection.openhands_policy: keep at most one strict segment per source trajectory and choose the exact subset whose final prompt-token sum is closest to request

arrival.note: Replay with --arrival frozen; starts are stored in workload.jsonl.
